caseNameFull: Pennington v. United Mine Workers of America
attorneys: John A. Rowntree and Robert S. Young, Jr., for petitioners., Edward L. Carey, Harrison Combs, Willard P. Owens, E. H. Ray son, and M. E. Boiarsky for respondent.

opinions.text:
C. A. 6th Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted. Mr. Justice Fortas took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
